title: 第6章 金牌杀手名单
slug: 魔兽剑圣异界纵横全本免费-魔兽剑圣异界纵横最新章节列表
content_zh:
分身弯腰从卡默手指上，瓣下一枚古朴的戒指，丢向刘枫。
顺手接过，在手中不断翻转把玩，有些不敢肯定的道：“空间戒指？这老家伙竟然有这等好东西。”
一丝神念附与其上，转眼间把上面的魔法印记消除的干干净净。
满意的点了点头，将之戴上左手中指。
心中一动，神念进入其中。
一片约莫三平方米左右的空间，里面杂七杂八的东西随处摆放，一些瓶瓶罐罐立于其中，想必那就是杀手的必备之物：毒药。另一处，摆着一叠整齐的文件。
心念微动，那叠文件出现在左手之上，借着微弱的月光，刘枫看清了那上面的文字：金牌杀手名单。
纸张随着双手的翻动，一个个臭名昭住的恶名跃于其上。
血翎，水晶级杀手，八阶影子刺客，事件：完成A级任务俩件，B级任务十三件，C级以及其下任务无数，曾参加过围剿圣阶高手的任务，虽未成功，但却是围剿的众多之人中，唯一逃出性命之人。
薛刹，水晶级杀手，八阶影子刺客，事件：曾完成A级任务一件，B级任务八件，C级以及其下任务无数，更是成功越阶刺杀一名星辰魔导师。
影鲨，黄金级杀手，七阶高级刺客，事件：完成B级任务五件，C级以及其下任务无数，曾成功刺杀在三位八阶高手保护之下，并且自身有着七阶实力的一位领主。
。。。。。。
。。。。。。。。。。
看着名单上一个个，都曾经轰动大陆一时的著名杀手，就连刘枫心中也是震惊不已。
“嘿嘿，盗贼工会拥有这样一群暗夜死神镰刀，想必它的对手们，对此也是头痛不已吧，而佣兵工会竟然能与它相抗衡这么多年而不落下风，实力也肯定不止表面上显露出来的那一点吧，果然是一群老狐狸。”刘枫在心中冷笑道。
扬了扬手中的一沓名单，刘枫心中暗道：“把这东西交给霍叔他们吧，想来他们会很高兴的吧，呵呵，看在菲儿的面子上，就帮你们一把。”
将名单收入戒指，向身后的树林腾跃去，转眼消失在幽影的黑幕中。
就在刘枫刚走后不久，一颗大树后，闪出俩条黑影，在死去的卡默身上不断摸索，象是在寻找什么东西。
片刻之后，一黑影手上一动，从卡默的内衣之中，摸出了一张薄薄的信封。
见到信封，黑影明显的松了一口气，对身边的另一黑影低声道：“还好，东西还在。”

身边的一黑影，闻言也是大大的松了一口气，嘴上催促道：“快点，我怕刚才那人又回转过来，我们不是他的对手。”
“恩，快走，”
“呵呵，俩位兄弟，能不能将你们手上的东西交给我？”一声轻笑从身后传来。
说话之人正是刘枫，他并没有离去，在刚才就凭借神念的入微就感觉到了藏身于大树之后的俩人，因不知道这俩人的目的，才佯装离去，躲在一旁将一切都看在眼里。
俩条黑影，身躯一颤，忽然，分头朝俩边疾射而去。
刘枫见状，轻轻一笑，道：“既然朋友如此不给面子，在下便只好自己动手了。”
********
“疾风步，启动。”
身影瞬间消失，疾射向朝左边逃跑的黑影。
黑影使了命的在狂奔，耳边的风啸之声告诉他，自己的速度很快。
心中小小的得意了一把，这种速度就算是七阶高手也跑出来的吧？
可是，得意的心情还没有缓过来，项间忽然一痛，天地间似乎旋转了起来，下面，一具无头尸体扑到在地，鲜血从断处急射而出。
“那具尸体，好面熟啊。。。。”这是黑影脑中闪现的最后意识。
诡异的出现在无头尸体身边的刘枫，低身在其身上摸索。
片刻后，明显没有收获的刘枫，俩手空空的耸了耸了肩，无所谓的道：“既然没在这人身上，那想必在他那同伴身上吧，分身应该能把他带回来吧？”
几分钟之后，一脸冷漠，一手柃着一条黑影的分身，在树林间翻腾跳跃而来。
不言不语的将黑影一把丢在刘枫身前，面色千篇一律的冷漠。
刘枫对这并不奇怪，毕竟它只是分身，没有自我的思考能力，相反，如果这时分身真的冒一句话语出来的话，刘枫才会骇得双眼巨凸。

content_en:
The clone bent down and took off a simple ring from Kamer's finger, and threw it towards Liu Feng.
He took it smoothly, turned it over and played with it in his hand, and said with some uncertainty: "Space ring? This old guy actually has such a good thing."
A trace of spiritual thought attached to it, and the magic mark on it was completely eliminated in the blink of an eye.
He nodded with satisfaction and put it on his left middle finger.
There was a movement in my heart, and my spiritual thoughts entered it.
There is a space of about three square meters, with miscellaneous things placed everywhere. Some bottles and jars stand in it, which must be the killer's essentials: poison. In another place, there is a neat stack of documents.
With a slight thought in his mind, the stack of documents appeared on his left hand. With the faint moonlight, Liu Feng could clearly read the words on it: List of Gold Medal Killers.
The paper was turned over with both hands, and notorious names appeared on it one by one.
Xue Ling, crystal-level killer, eighth-level shadow assassin, events: Completed two A-level tasks, thirteen B-level tasks, countless C-level and below tasks. He once participated in the mission to encircle and suppress holy-level masters. Although he was unsuccessful, he was the only one to escape with his life among the many people in the encirclement and suppression.
Xue Cha, crystal-level killer, eighth-level shadow assassin, events: completed one A-level mission, eight B-level missions, countless C-level and below missions, and even successfully assassinated a star magister across ranks.
Shadow Shark, a gold-level killer, a seventh-level senior assassin, event: Completed five B-level tasks, countless C-level and below tasks, and successfully assassinated a lord who was protected by three eighth-level masters and had a seventh-level strength.
. . . . . .
. . . . . . . . . .
Looking at the famous killers on the list who once caused a sensation in the mainland, even Liu Feng was shocked.
"Hey, the Thieves Guild has such a group of Night Death Sickles. It must be a headache for its opponents. However, the Mercenary Guild has been able to compete with it for so many years without falling behind. Its strength must be more than what is shown on the surface. It is indeed a group of old foxes." Liu Feng sneered in his heart.
Raising the stack of lists in his hand, Liu Feng thought to himself: "Give this to Uncle Huo and the others. I think they will be very happy. Haha, for Fei'er's sake, I will help you."
Putting the list into the ring, he leaped towards the woods behind him and disappeared into the shadowy black curtain in an instant.
Not long after Liu Feng left, two dark figures flashed out from behind a big tree, groping over the dead Kamer as if they were looking for something.
After a moment, a dark figure moved his hand and took out a thin envelope from Kammer's underwear.
Seeing the envelope, the shadow was obviously relieved, and whispered to the other shadow next to him: "Fortunately, the things are still there."
A dark figure next to him breathed a sigh of relief when he heard this, and urged: "Hurry up, I'm afraid that the man just turned around again, and we are no match for him."
"Well, let's go quickly,"
"Haha, brothers, can you give me what you have in your hands?" A chuckle came from behind.
The person who spoke was none other than Liu Feng. He did not leave. Just now, he had sensed the two people hiding behind the big tree with his spiritual consciousness. Because he did not know the purpose of these two people, he pretended to leave and hid aside to watch everything.
The two black shadows trembled, and suddenly they shot apart in both directions.
When Liu Feng saw this, he smiled softly and said, "Since my friend is so disrespectful, I have no choice but to take action myself."
**********
"Wind Step, start."
The figure disappeared in an instant and shot towards the black figure running to the left.
The black shadow was running as fast as he could, and the sound of wind whistling in his ears told him that he was going very fast.
I felt a little proud in my heart. Even a seventh-level master could run at this speed, right?However, the proud mood had not yet calmed down. There was a sudden pain in his neck, and the world seemed to be spinning. Below, a headless corpse fell to the ground, and blood spurted out from the broken part.
"That corpse looks so familiar..." This was the last thought that flashed through Heiying's mind.
Liu Feng appeared strangely next to the headless corpse, lowered his body and groped around on it.
After a moment, Liu Feng, who had obviously gained nothing, shrugged with empty hands and said nonchalantly: "Since it's not on this person, it must be on his companion. The clone should be able to bring him back, right?"
A few minutes later, a clone with an indifferent face and a black shadow in one hand jumped through the woods.
Without saying a word, he threw the black shadow in front of Liu Feng, with the same indifferent expression.
Liu Feng was not surprised by this. After all, it was just a clone and had no ability to think on its own. On the contrary, if the clone really said a word at this time, Liu Feng would be so horrified that his eyes would bulge.
